user.title: Assist Router
user.description: Adds the “Assist Router” conversation agent. It behaves like the built-in Home Assistant agent; when a command is not recognized it can route the question with a small Ollama model, ask a fallback agent, and log the command to /config/assist/unrecognized_commands.csv. Select it as the conversation agent in your pipelines under Settings → Voice assistants.

router.title: Question router
router.description: The router model only picks the topic of the question. The optional answer model writes the reply to the user's question from the Home Assistant data, and summarizes Wikipedia articles.

data_description.router_model: It only picks a topic; e.g. Bielik Minitron 7B (about 0.5 s).
data_description.router_timeout: Also used for the Wikipedia search.
data_description.router_keep_alive: For both models: minutes after the last question; -1 = always loaded (fastest answer).
data_description.answer_model: Optional. Without it the automation response (or the first sentences of the article) is read as is.
data_description.answer_timeout: If it does not answer in time, the automation response is read.

settings.title: Assist Router
settings.description: What happens when Home Assistant does not recognize a command.

data_description.log_unrecognized: Append each unrecognized command to /config/assist/unrecognized_commands.csv and fire the assist_router_unrecognized event.
data_description.fallback_agent: Answers questions the router could not handle (e.g. Bielik 11B). Leave empty to keep the “Powiedziałeś: …” message.
data_description.fallback_timeout: If the agent does not answer in time, the “Powiedziałeś: …” message is spoken.
data_description.ollama_url: E.g. http://localhost:11434. Leave empty to disable the router. Topics are defined in /config/assist/router.yaml.

router_file.title: router.yaml
router_file.description:
File `{path}` - the router's topics, people and data sources. It is validated before saving; the previous version is kept as `router.yaml.bak`. The router picks up changes immediately, without a restart.

{error}

examples.title: Example commands
examples.description:
Sentences for your home, checked with the router (control commands with a plan, nothing executed). File: `{path}`; also the "Example commands" sensor.

{examples}

log.title: Unrecognized commands
log.description:
File `{path}`: {count} entries, the last {shown} below (newest first). Everything: the CSV file or the "Unrecognized commands" sensor.

{table}

data.clear: Clear the log (a copy is kept as .bak)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Ollama at this address.
error.invalid_router: The router file is invalid - nothing was saved.

progress.generating: The model writes sentences from your entities and the router checks each one. This takes a few minutes - you can close this window, the file is saved anyway.

abort.router_saved: Saved `{path}`. The router uses the new version from the next question.

generate_examples.name: Generate example commands
generate_examples.description: The answer model writes sentences for every router.yaml topic with your entity and people names; the router checks each one (control: a plan, nothing executed). Result: /config/assist/router_examples.yaml and the "Example commands" sensor.

per_topic.name: Sentences per topic
per_topic.description: How many working sentences to keep per topic.

clear_log.name: Clear the unrecognized log
clear_log.description: Clears /config/assist/unrecognized_commands.csv (the header stays); the previous content is kept as unrecognized_commands.csv.bak.
